text: Quality assurance per EN 14181: QAL2 (calibration and variability test by an accredited laboratory after installation), QAL3 (control charts with automatic zero and span check), AST (annual surveillance test by an accredited laboratory); the measurement location and sampling per EN 15259 with permanent access platform, sampling ports and a homogeneous sample point at the stack (10HNE10 with CEMS platform).
